cache_policy: preserve all existing Hugging Face caches; do not reuse a mixed global cache for formal model loading

calibration.order: frozen manifest order; no resampling or tokenizer re-encoding
calibration.source: frozen v16/v18/v19 WikiText-2 train manifest, reused byte-identically

formal_m3_authorized_conditionally: Only if exact model identity, tokenizer identity, quant-off parity, 2048 memory and conservative local 24-hour cost gates all pass.

frozen_training_semantics.iteration_semantics: each scheduled sample is consumed once; native GradScaler may skip optimizer steps; no retry or compensating sample
frozen_training_semantics.optimizer_scaler_resume: fresh native AdamW and dynamic GradScaler for each new decoder block, consistent with upstream block boundary semantics

preflight_semantics: reuse v21/v20.1 runner and timing module; only execute after exact isolated model load and 64-token native/port parity PASS

quantization_and_training.loss: official block reconstruction; FP teacher and quantized student
quantization_and_training.optimizer_semantics: frozen v20/v20.1 AdamW and AMP semantics; no optimizer/algorithm edits
quantization_and_training.weight_quantization: official asymmetric affine [0,15] per output row and consecutive G128 input groups

resume_authority: v21.3 FORMAL_RESUME_PLAN.md; completed-block-only resume from block_20
scope: frozen WT2 and fixed-budget C4 evaluation
start_from: pristine FP; no historical M3 parameters loaded
workload: 24 blocks x 20 epochs x 128 samples; batch=1, seqlen=2048
timing_rule: monotonic; GPU sync only at newly added stage boundaries; pre-existing step sync/checks retained
sampler: external supervisor; target period 0.2 s; device total and each accessible process RSS; flush each tick
allocator_rule: save each stage peak before reset; full peak is max of all stages, including failed stage
diagnostic_scope: v21.4 existing finite/AMP/checkpoint diagnostics retained for all blocks; historical prefix diagnostics were less detailed
cost_comparison: new measured run, not reconstruction of historical elapsed time; no M1/M2 speed ratio
